tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search the live, published Revamp Vacations catalog across Armenia: places to stay, tours, experiences, restaurants (eat), and places to visit. Returns matching listings with a link to each. All data is real and current.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch full details for one listing by its slug (from search_listings), including description, amenities, highlights, and the booking link.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a stay is available for a date range. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; end date is the check-out day (exclusive). Returns whether the range is free plus the listing's busy ranges.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Generate a day-by-day Armenia itinerary grounded in Revamp's live catalog (real stays, tours, experiences, restaurants). Returns a structured plan.
